name: Marigold Town
blurb: A sleepy town under the noon sun. The clinic and the general store are always open.

name: Tallgrass Meadow
blurb: Waist-high grass where young Billies play hide-and-seek.

name: Old Fairway
blurb: Eighteen holes gone wild. Watch out for the sand traps.

name: Thornberry Wood
blurb: Dense brush full of nests, burrows and the occasional lost golf ball.

name: Fizzwell Town
blurb: A cave town where warm springs bubble up from the rock. Bring a hat.

name: Stepstone Canyon
blurb: A canyon of carved stone steps. Every single one goes down.
gateText: The steps down to Route 5 · Stepstone Canyon open once you earn Leader Rocco’s Ground Badge.

name: Rustgear Yard
blurb: Heaps of old machines, crates and lost things, sorted by nobody.
gateText: The road into Rustgear Yard opens once you earn Leader Rocco’s Ground Badge.

name: Pepperpot Town
blurb: A town built around one enormous food court. The pretzels are warm.

name: Lanternhall City
blurb: The biggest mall in the Hollow Earth. It grew out of the rock like coral.

name: Willowmere
blurb: A quiet pond ringed with willows and cattails. Something splashes now and then.

name: Clovercrest Town
blurb: A little farming hamlet with a windmill, a clinic and the best apples around.

name: Kitewind Ridge
blurb: A windy ridge high above the canyon. On a clear noon you can see the far side of the world.

name: Verdigris City
blurb: The big city in the middle of the inner world: towers, traffic, a fountain plaza and shops that never close.

name: Driftwreck Bay
blurb: Open water west of Marigold Town, dotted with sandbars, buoys and a lighthouse. Only a Water Billie big enough to ride can carry you across.

name: Palmhaven Town
blurb: A sunny island town of white villas, yachts and very discreet bank accounts. Nobody here pays for anything, officially.

name: Mt. Cinderpeak
gateText: The path up Mt. Cinderpeak opens once you earn Leader Marina’s Water Badge in Palmhaven Town.
blurb: A grumbling volcano on Palmhaven’s north shore. Lava rivers, obsidian and steam vents, and the hottest Billies in the Hollow Earth.

name: Hornpass
gateText: Hornpass opens once you earn Leader Iris’s Steel Badge in Lanternhall City.
blurb: A snowy pass north of Verdigris City: pines, rope bridges over misty gorges and a hut with hot cocoa.

name: Frostcrown Town
blurb: A mountain town of chalets stacked up the slope, with the thinnest air and the highest rents in the Hollow Earth.

name: Mirrormere Lake
blurb: A wide, calm lake between Clovercrest Town and Frostcrown Town, with reedy islands and a floating market. You need a Billie to ride across.

name: Fanfare Fields
blurb: Wildflower fields east of the Mall, where Vinylla’s fan festival never ends and the merch never runs out.
gateText: The road east of Lanternhall City opens once you hold all four badges of the ring: the last is Leader Marina’s Water Badge, in Palmhaven Town.

name: Twinpetal Town
blurb: A market village where everything grows back twice as fast. The merch stalls arrived on their own.

name: Petalfall Vale
blurb: A valley of cherry trees by a stream. The petals fall all year, and somebody sweeps them all year.

name: Rootwater Marsh
blurb: Boardwalks through a mangrove swamp at the edge of the Meadowlands. The margins are thin here.
gateText: The boardwalks south-east of Twinpetal Town open once you earn Leader Poppy’s Grass Badge.

name: Grapevine Hills
blurb: Vineyards on sunburnt hills. Under the rows are the old stone vaults, and in the vaults are Vinylla’s variants.

name: Goldvine Town
blurb: A vineyard estate with vaults under every hill. Baron Vault owns all of it, and has rented all of it out.

name: Saltpan Flats
blurb: Salt flats as far as you can see, and one tollbooth in the middle of them. Everyone pays the same.

name: Grizzle Badlands
blurb: Red rock and old mines. The big rock that looks like a sleeping bear has been asleep for a very long time.
gateText: The badlands east of Goldvine Town open once you earn Baron Vault’s Fire Badge.

name: Puffcap Woods
blurb: A wood of giant mushrooms puffing glittering spores. The Variants have built a mill in it.

name: Capshade Town
blurb: A village in and under the mushrooms, round one mushroom so big it has a door. Its value goes up and down with the spores.

name: Russetwood
blurb: A wood where it is always autumn. The leaves fall every quarter, on schedule.

name: Tanglewild Jungle
blurb: A jungle that grew over a start-up campus in a single quarter. It is still growing. So, they say, is the start-up.
gateText: The jungle east of Capshade Town opens once you earn Mother Morel’s Psychic Badge.

name: Prism Chasm
blurb: Chasms full of crystal, crossed on rope bridges. The Variants have set up a works on the shelf between them.

name: Glimmershaft Town
blurb: A mining town in a cavern, lit by lanterns and the crystals in its walls. Leader Carat runs the mine and the arena.

name: Gloomwater Pool
blurb: An underground lake so still it looks like a hole in the floor. The old miners’ beacon still burns on the point.

name: Rimefrost Caves
blurb: Ice caves opening on to a frozen plain. Something valuable is frozen in a block of ice, where nobody can spend it.
gateText: The ice caves east of Glimmershaft Town open once you earn Leader Carat’s Electric Badge.

name: Conchshell Shoals
blurb: Tide pools and reef shallows on the shore of the inner sea, where a great many companies are registered inside one shell.

name: Kelpport City
blurb: A harbour of yachts and piers. Every boat here is diversified; most of them have never left.

name: Abyssal Trench
blurb: Open water over the trench, so deep the bottom line has never been found. You cross it on a Water Billie.

name: Vinyl Works
blurb: Sheds on piles over the trench, venting steam. Inside, Vinylla’s record is being pressed, one test copy at a time.

name: Circuit Terraces
blurb: Silicon flats: rows of servers humming in the fields and solar panels where the crops used to be. The Cloud is made here.

name: Nimbus City
blurb: The city at the foot of the Spire. Its night market never closes, because the tower’s shadow makes it night all day on one side.

name: Fizzpop Fair
blurb: A theme park that closed the day the bubble burst. The Ferris wheel stopped with everyone’s money still at the top.

name: Skygarden Walk
blurb: Walkways up the Spire through the clouds, to the door of Vinylla’s penthouse.

name: Zenith Steps
blurb: A desert of sun-baked stone under the Inner Sun. Everything here peaked a long time ago.

name: Bellwether Rise
blurb: The road to the Inner Sun, past the great bell. When it rings, everything stops trading.

name: The Inner Sun
blurb: Always noon at the centre of the world. The press stands ready under the sun.

name: Copperleaf Town
blurb: A hamlet of round doors and moss roofs, where things from the surface come down. Professor Hazel’s lab, Granny Juniper’s bees, and nothing to buy.

name: Hedgerow Lane
blurb: A short lane between hedgerows full of dog roses and blackberries, from Copperleaf down to Marigold Town. Mind the stepping stones.

name: Pearlantis City
blurb: The old money’s city under a glass dome at the bottom of the trench: chrome and pearl towers, bubble trams, kelp gardens. A glass lift in Kelpport goes down.
